name: uml_review_knowledge_bundle
description: Generate review context, how-it-works guides, and the full navigable UML review site as one knowledge bundle.

inputs.context_output_dir: Optional output directory for the context bundle. Defaults to Docs/uml/review_context.
inputs.guide_output_dir: Optional output directory for the guide bundle. Defaults to Docs/uml/how_it_works.
inputs.site_output_dir: Optional output directory for the review site. Defaults to Docs/uml/review_site.
inputs.site_title: Optional site title. Defaults to UML Review Explorer.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the scan. Defaults to false.
inputs.neighbor_depth: How far module neighborhoods should be expanded for context. Defaults to 1.
inputs.max_neighbors: Maximum neighbor modules retained per module. Defaults to 10.

outputs.context: Paths for generated review context files.
outputs.guides: Paths for generated how-it-works guide files.
outputs.site: Paths for generated review site files.
